research_candidates_not_applied.premise: The current Hall/pair filter is sound: every genuine completion survives it.
research_candidates_not_applied.rule: If filtering A together with the temporary assumption X_F=a yields a checked contradiction, delete a from D_F before any permanent commitment.
research_candidates_not_applied.proof: Let Omega(A) be all valid full colorings satisfying current anchors A. A checked sound-filter contradiction under X_F=a implies Omega(A) intersect {X_F=a} is empty. Thus deleting a preserves every completion of A.
research_candidates_not_applied.boundary: This is explicitly conditional probing, not mere renaming or a new ordering. It can be bounded to individual names without enumerating full colorings, but it may still leave globally unsupported names and proves no universal success.

research_candidates_not_applied.rule: Retain jointly allowed boundary triples (a,b,c), rather than only independent single-name domains and pair projections; remove a tuple only with a checked reason.
research_candidates_not_applied.boundary: Pairwise supports need not give a common joint support. Triple tables require an explicit sound update/checking rule and still do not imply global completeness.

research_candidates_not_applied.rule: Under X_F=a, propagate only justified exclusions to temporary domains D'_v. For a clique Q, if the union of D'_v over v in Q has size less than |Q|, reject a.
research_candidates_not_applied.boundary: The inequality is a valid contradiction certificate, not evidence that this simple check detects the present examples or adds power beyond existing Hall rules.
